teaser: The vet clinic waiting room has one chair with a wobble nobody fixes, and you are the one who finally wedges a folded receipt under its leg. Life path 6 and the four letters of ISTJ meet in that kind of gesture: care delivered as upkeep, love delivered as a task completed. The 6 carries a pull toward tending whoever is nearby; ISTJ carries a habit of doing what needs doing, quietly, on schedule. Crossed, the tending stops being a feeling and becomes a function — the thing you handle because somebody has to, and you already know how.
